name: Avocado Toast with Tomatoes & Sesame Seeds
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Arrange bread on a baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Add spices to the bowl with the avocado, then mash once more to combine the spread. Set aside.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise.
Divide avocado spread between toast slices and smooth out in an even layer; top with tomatoes.
To serve, divide avocado toast between plates; sprinkle with sesame seeds and additional salt. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
